DOP: ghurughuru ind. [ onomat.; cf S. ghuraghurā, ghuru-ghurā], a noise of snoring or snorting or wheezing ; Th-a III 56, 39 (so parihīnajavo ~ū ti passasanto kacchehi sedaṃ muñcanto pādaṃ uddharituṃ pi asakkonto, Ce so; Ee ~u ti; Be, Se °-passāsī); — °- passāsa , mfn. , breathing with a snort, snoring; wheezing ; Ja I 160, 28 (tesu niddaṃ upagatesu ekacce ~ā kākacchamānā dante khādantā nipajjiṃsu, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se gharugharu-); — °- passāsi(n) , mfn. , breathing with a snort, snoring; wheezing and puffing ; S I 117, 21 (jiṇṇo gopānasivaṅko ~ī); Sv 42, 27 (dante khādantā kākacchamānā ~ino sayanti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se gharugharu-); Pj II 189, 19 (so akkhīhi niggatehi … ~ī dukkhaṃ vediyati, Ce, Ee so; Se vedayati; Be gharugharupassāsī dukkhaṃ vedayati); Th-a I 73, 19 (nisinno ~ī niddāyat’ eva, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr ~iṃ).
